purpose: Compact date or date-time control that opens a calendar popover for selection.

notes: Use VeliProvider for Veli locale, language, and popover direction.

useWhen: A form needs compact date selection with a calendar available on demand.
Users need minimum, maximum, or unavailable-date constraints in the calendar.
A selected date or date-time should be shown in locale-aware formatted text.

avoidWhen.situation: The calendar must remain visible for scheduling or availability browsing.
Users need direct segment-by-segment keyboard entry without a popover.

supportedInteractions: Open a calendar popover from the field trigger.
Select a date with mouse, touch, or keyboard.
Select dates subject to minimum, maximum, and availability rules.
Present required, invalid, disabled, and read-only states.
approvedPatterns: Provide a visible label for form use.
Use description text for guidance and errorMessage for invalid-state recovery.
Use the placeholder to state the expected selection when no value exists.
Use granularity and hour cycle when displaying date-time values.
limitations: The current trigger displays formatted text in a button rather than editable date segments.
The popover contains the single-date Calendar component, not RangeCalendar.
Helper description is hidden while the picker is invalid.
accessibility: The visible label is associated with the React Aria date picker.
The trigger has a visible keyboard focus ring.
The calendar icon is hidden from assistive technology.
Disabled and read-only states preserve their underlying React Aria semantics.
responsive: The trigger fills its container; constrain the parent to the intended form width.
Ensure narrow viewports can accommodate the calendar popover's fixed-width grid.
rtl: VeliProvider can supply Dhivehi locale and RTL direction.
The popover receives the active language and direction.
Trigger text uses logical start alignment.
